card: The screen counts ballots the runtime refuses: pin it to runtime vectors
tests_added: packages/stage-kit/src/ballots.test.ts::ballot vectors from the runtime (coverage + 11 per-scenario agreement cases + declared-deviation check)
packages/stage-kit/src/ballots.test.ts::the acceptance cases, by name (prefix, summon in crowd poll, ranks/case/index/re-vote, no crown before the first tally)
packages/stage-kit/src/scene.test.ts::matches options by index and exact text, never by prefix, as the runtime does (strengthened from the unique-prefix test)
packages/stage-kit/src/scene.test.ts::counts !summon only in a foil vote: a crowd poll ignores it
guard_cases: acceptance 3 (crowd poll ranks/case/index/re-vote): agreed with the runtime before by coincidence; green before by design, now compared against runtime output
deviations_from_card: (1) Acceptance 1: a runtime-opened foil vote always holds its opener's ballot, so the scenario opens with `!summon the-life-coach` and checks the-disruptor has 0 voters on both sides (not the whole tally at 0). (2) Vectors surfaced a 4th disagreement the card did not list: a transcript logs a chat batch before the runtime's start_poll, so the summon that opens a foil vote (and later ballots in its batch) was never counted on screen. Fixed rather than declared: SceneState.pendingBallots (sceneModel.ts) holds ballot lines seen with no poll open until the next non-chat/non-input-verdict event; a foil-vote start_poll casts them from the first known-foil summon on (ballots.ts openFoilVote), mirroring ingest_chat. Scenario summon_batch_opens_foil_vote pins it. (3) Also aligned: index-before-text (options ['2','1'] + `!vote 1` -> '2'), out-of-range number falls back to exact text, `+N` index, ASCII-only case folding (runtime eq_ignore_ascii_case). (4) Two declared deviations: command_from_text and poll_kind_from_id (a crowd poll the brain names `foil-vote-N` takes `!summon` on screen only). (5) Coupled file outside write set: packages/stage-kit/tsconfig.json gains resolveJsonModule, because the repo's eslint forbids JSON.parse outside the contract door; the test imports the JSON module and passes every event through parseStreamEvent. (6) 13 scenarios (card: 8-12). lines_changed is dominated by the generated 2.6k-line JSON (~47 KB; scenario events include the runtime's start() events).
notes: Runtime vote semantics untouched; the Rust side is one new integration test. Hand-edited golden -> fails with 'scenario `zero_voter_row` differs'; UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 rewrote it byte-identical (cmp). castBallot now takes a Voter {id, rank} and a Command (exported from index via ballots.ts, as are matchOption, ballotOption, openFoilVote, observedTally, BALLOT_DEVIATIONS, FOIL_VOTE_PREFIX). For slot B: Poll.ballots/observed are still Records copied per ballot (castBallot in ballots.ts is the one place to change); pendingBallots is an array copied per pending line, capped at PENDING_BALLOT_MAX=256 and cleared every non-chat event. pollBars still falls back to chat-observed weights before the first runtime tally, now under the runtime's rule. packages/stage-kit/nul predates this work (not mine). apps/console build not run (no app files touched; stage-kit runtime additions are a few hundred bytes).
